title: Drift skill against NOAA Global Drifter Program trajectories
drifters: NOAA AOML GDP 6-hour interpolated QC (drifter_6hour_qc, AOML ERDDAP)
metric: Separation between simulated and observed positions at 24/48/72 h, and the Liu & Weisberg (2011) skill score (n = 1): 1 = perfect, 0 = no skill.
notes: Drogued SVP drifters follow the ~15 m current; HYCOM surface currents are compared directly.
The 'HYCOM + wind' run adds 1 % of the NCEP R2 10 m wind (assumed undrogued slip); it is scored on all segments for comparison.
Segments whose simulation strands on the 1/8 deg coastline or leaves the domain are not scored.
The previous model uses the single ARMOR3D geostrophic field of 2024-12-31 for dates months later, which is exactly the limitation this comparison quantifies.
